description: This file implements a client for managing scale subresources in Kubernetes, providing methods to get, update, and patch scale objects within specific namespaces, utilizing dynamic resource resolution and version handling.

classes.name: scaleClient
classes.description: Client implementation for managing scale resources, resolving resource paths and versions.

methods.description: Constructs a scale client with a given REST client and resource resolution components.
